evidencePolicy: Only public-safe fields supported by authoritative or controlled project records are displayed. Draft-only or unbound research candidates are never promoted to Verified Active. Candidate records may be counted or displayed only when their candidate status itself is supported by a public-safe controlled record. Milestone-to-output and project-to-publication links are shown only when the relationship itself is verified.
